# asc_vnic (Resource)

Manages an ASC virtual network interface (VNIC). Attach it to a virtual machine by listing its urn in the machine's vnics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A virtual network interface in the inline subnet of the asc_vpc example. It
# gets its private IP from that subnet; attach it by listing its urn in an
# asc_virtual_machine's vnics.
resource "asc_vnic" "example" {
  subnet_urn = asc_vpc.example.subnets[0].urn

  # Optional: ASC chooses a name when it is omitted.
  name = "example-eth0"

  tags = {
    env = "production"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subnet_urn` (String) URN of the subnet the VNIC takes its private IP from. Changing it replaces the VNIC.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the VNIC, 1 to 50 characters. Changing it renames the VNIC in place.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the VNIC. Changing tags updates the VNIC in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the VNIC, the last segment of its URN.
- `last_error` (String) Last error reported for the VNIC, empty when healthy.
- `mac` (String) MAC address of the VNIC.
- `private_ip` (String) Private IP address of the VNIC in its subnet.
- `public_ip` (String) Public IP address of the VNIC, empty when it has none.
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle status, for example detached or attached.
- `urn` (String) URN of the VNIC.
- `vm_urn` (String) URN of the virtual machine the VNIC is attached to, empty when detached.
